# QuincaiSoft

> QuincaiSoft, by Opesware Technologies, is an ERP and point-of-sale product for retail, trade and distribution businesses (hardware shops, construction-material retailers, wholesalers and distributors) in Cameroon and the CEMAC region. It is bilingual (English and French), works in FCFA (XAF) and supports several branches. It is in active development and is not claimed to be production-certified.

Key limitations (stated honestly):
- No DGI fiscal approval, OHADA conformity or other certification is claimed.
- MTN Mobile Money: adapter exists; live credentials and provider acceptance still required. Orange Money: not integrated (pending contracted integration).
- Offline posting of sales on mobile is currently disabled until stock-quota and device evidence are complete.
- No public prices: contact the company for pricing.

## Product pages and guides (English)
- [Mobile app](https://quincaisoft.com/en/mobile-app): included in every plan; offline sale drafts; offline posting disabled
- [Payments](https://quincaisoft.com/en/payments): cash, credit, deposits, MTN adapter status, Orange Money not integrated, no custody of funds
- [Online store](https://quincaisoft.com/en/online-store): optional published catalogue; no checkout yet
- [Security](https://quincaisoft.com/en/security): row-level tenant isolation, audit trail, idempotency, roles, OIDC; no certifications claimed
- [Windows desktop](https://quincaisoft.com/en/desktop): existing software stays standalone; sync adapter integration pending
- [Migration and onboarding](https://quincaisoft.com/en/migration-and-onboarding): planned onboarding path
- [Choosing retail software in CEMAC](https://quincaisoft.com/en/compare): neutral checklist
- [Resources](https://quincaisoft.com/en/resources): six practical guides (bulk materials in FCFA, customer credit, supplier receiving, contractor quotations, multiple branches, mobile money reconciliation)
